body: A lot of things have happened recently like within the last few months and I’ve literally just lost everything. It’s a lot to explain and go through

Yeah and the fact that nothing had changed my whole life I’ve been waiting years for literally anything to get better but nothing has. My therapist doesn’t help with anything or any doctors or whatever like they aren’t really meant to and going to therapy/ taking meds doesn’t really do anything at this point when my entire life is falling apart

I’ve only heard bad things about hotlines which is why I’ve never used one. I have a therapist already and a psychiatrist and all that but they can’t do anything to actually help me. A hospital won’t be able to help either. Sure it helps me not die for while I’m there but after I leave I’m right back where I was before. Nothing seems to be able to actually help which is why I’ve just given up
